acceptance_notes: Concept board: reference only, never shipped, no manifest entry (ASSET_PIPELINE 10.13). Accepted run_00, the single candidate of the SSP-012 smoke run (one candidate by design: no looping for luck), after reading review.png and run_00/street.png. Why it is kept: the roofs, pavements, road markings, zebra crossing and promenade read as straight down; the layout follows the brief top to bottom; the yellow sweeper with red brushes leaves a visibly cleaner stripe through the grime; the people read as a high three-quarter cheat at a small size; litter is scattered in the gutters; no text, lettering, logos or brand-like marks. Verified by the wrapper: byte-identical to the thread's image_gen exec-*.png, and events.jsonl shows only a cat of the skill file and a cp (no drawing). Caveats for anyone using it as a style reference: the cars and the sweeper show their sides and wheels (a three-quarter cheat; ART_BIBLE vehicles are strictly overhead), the colours are not limited to Kerbside-32, the road grime is noisy speckle rather than clean pixel clusters, and it added a sea strip below the beach that the brief did not ask for. Shadows fall to the right as briefed.
